title: Regulatory Authority Interior
purpose: Regulators sector card and supervisory-authority surfaces.
story: The interior of a regulatory authority at dusk — the measured stillness of oversight, ledgers closed and order kept.
environment: A long galleried office hall, ranked desks beneath a high glazed ceiling, partitions dissolving into shadow.
architecture: Edwardian institutional interior — cast-iron columns, a glazed roof lantern, a mezzanine balustrade above the floor.
composition: Ranks of desks marching toward a dim vanishing point, a warm shaft crossing the floor, the roof lantern lost in negative space above.
continuityNotes: Keeps the set's near-black grade with one warm shaft and brass-on-black palette consistent with scene-01.
